integrity: Exact induction and explicit extremizing family. Auxiliary finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof. Historical priority is provisional. No independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp uniform infimum for stacked convex polytopes, not an exact per-polytope toughness formula. The component inequality need not be individually sharp. No extension is claimed for general simplicial polytopes or general k-trees.
title: A sharp toughness threshold for stacked polytopes
